note: Target acceptance requirements, not passing tests. Milestone = earliest owning task; R097 accrues across T24/T27/T29/T32. R081-R131 come from SPEC_AMENDMENTS.md. suggested_test paths are targets to implement. Status vocabulary: evidence_status NOT_RUN or RECORDED_LOCALLY (the tests in evidence_paths pass in scripts/check.py and CI; the suggested_test acceptance file does not exist yet); implementation_status NOT_IMPLEMENTED_OR_NOT_TARGET_VERIFIED or IMPLEMENTED_LOCALLY_VERIFIED (the core library or contract exists and those tests verify it; no running target capability). RECORDED_LOCALLY_LIVE: the test passes against the running dev profile with OPS_LIVE=1 and is collected but skipped by scripts/check.py and CI; the evidence file records a run.

requirements.requirement: No content author may approve the proposal

requirements.requirement: Definer functions are hardened and tenant-isolated by explicit policies

requirements.requirement: Fenced writes lock the lease row and follow one lock order

requirements.requirement: Graphs persist synchronously and resume from the stored checkpoint

requirements.requirement: Cluster NetworkPolicy is actually enforced (optional)

requirements.requirement: Feedback is recorded without changing runtime behaviour
requirements.expected_evidence: Feedback endpoint stores classified feedback, emits feedback.recorded, alters no prompt/policy/permission.

requirements.requirement: Errors use the safe schema and documented status mapping

requirements.requirement: Relocated reference stays byte-identical and runnable

requirements.requirement: Checkpoint tables are reachable only by the worker

requirements.requirement: A second incident for the same asset and interval requires an explicit supersession
requirements.expected_evidence: Two approved runs on one asset/interval: the second grant is refused (asset_incident_exists) whenever a committed incident exists, in any order; it proceeds only when runs.supersedes_run_id, set from the requester's structured request, names that run and the reviewer approved the payload that freeze_proposal built from it; a draft carrying supersedes_run_id fails validation.

requirements.requirement: Test time cannot be shifted outside the test profile

requirements.requirement: Every route is enumerable and unroutable input never starts work

requirements.expected_evidence: mcp_read can EXECUTE only resolve_invocation, asset_scope, search_procedures_scoped; mcp_exec only resolve_invocation, grant_execution, mark_sent, record_outcome, request_abort, lookup_action (pg_proc ACL test); an execute/recover handle at mcp-read and a read handle at mcp-write are rejected; incident-sim rejects mcp-read's token.
